summary: Trigger and menu that shows, hides and optionally reorders the data points a view renders.
useWhen: A card list, map overlay or other non-table view lets the viewer choose which data points appear.
A toolbar needs Customize as a peer of Filter, Sort and Group rather than a tab inside Preferences.
avoidWhen: The view is a ds-table. Table owns its column customizer through columnCustomizer, which locks the last visible column and reorders columns.

alternatives.when: The choice is one submitted form value.
alternatives.reason: Select owns form-value and listbox semantics rather than view customization.

accessibility: The trigger and menu share an accessible name derived from the visible label unless the application supplies a more contextual name.
Rows are switches, so each one announces its own checked state.
states: reorderable is off by default, so rows are switches with no drag handle. Turn it on only where a display order exists.
minVisible is zero by default, so every field may be hidden. Raise it when the view needs a data point to stay visible.
catalogHeader labels the field rows; it is omitted unless options supply a second section, in which case it defaults to Data.
options render as their own Options section and emit dsOptionChange rather than a field config change.
dsFieldsConfigChange emits hiddenFieldIds and fieldOrder together, so a consumer that never reorders can ignore fieldOrder.
responsiveBehavior: The owning standalone data toolbar determines when the trigger becomes icon-only; its accessible name and focus tooltip preserve the action label.

customElements: Assign the field catalog and configuration arrays as JavaScript properties. Apply field visibility and order changes to the view, then replace the controlled inputs; handle extra option changes separately.
react: Keep field visibility and display order in application state, pass new array references after changes, and use the same state to render the view.
angular: Bind the field catalog and configuration arrays as properties through the generated adapter. Replace the controlled configuration from event.detail and keep extra option state in the application.
